client_socket.description: Unix socket file path for local (non-TCP) client connections.

client_default_character_set.description: Default character set used by the client (e.g., 'utf8mb4', 'latin1').

client_ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for client connections (requires certificates).

client_ssl_ca.description: Path to CA certificate for SSL verification (only if SSL enabled).

client_ssl_cert.description: Path to client certificate file (only if SSL enabled).

client_ssl_key.description: Path to client private key file (only if SSL enabled).

client_additional_options.description: Key-value pairs of additional arbitrary client options (e.g., { 'connect_timeout': '60', 'max_allowed_packet': '64M' }).

mysql_pager_enabled.description: Enable the pager program (e.g., `less`) for command output in the `mysql` CLI.

mysql_pager.description: Pager command to use when `mysql_pager_enabled` is true (e.g., 'less', 'more', 'less -S').

mysql_vertical_output_enabled.description: Show query results vertically by default (like `\G`), useful for wide rows.
